title: Han Seng Juan buys S$242K of Centurion Corp Ltd shares
body: Han Seng Juan bought 200,000 shares of Centurion Corp Ltd in a market transaction at S$1.21 per share, for a total of S$242,000. Total interest rises from 374,452,326 shares (44.54%) to 374,652,326 shares (44.56%).
deemed_interest_text: (1) Mr Han Seng Juan ("Mr Han") holds a 50% shareholding interest in Centurion Global Ltd (“Centurion Global”).       Centurion Properties Pte. Ltd. (“Centurion Properties”) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Centurion Global. Mr Han is, therefore, deemed to have an interest in 225,756,126 shares held by Centurion Properties in the       Company. (2) Mr Han is also deemed to have an interest in 7,947,500 shares held by his spouse, Kang Lee Cheng Susanna,       which are registered in the name of DB Nominees (Singapore) Pte Ltd. (3) Mr Han is the beneficial owner of 10,110,400 shares held by Sunsprings Holdings Ltd and is deemed to have an       interest in these shares, which are registered in the name of Citibank Nominees Singapore Pte Ltd.
remarks_text: (1)  Of the 130,838,300 shares held by Mr Han, 25,064,000 shares are registered in the name of Citibank Nominees        Singapore Pte Ltd, 11,283,300 shares are registered in the name of UOB Kay Hian Pte Ltd, 402,300 shares are        registered in the name of Oversea-Chinese Bank Nominees Pte Ltd, 6,827,500 shares are registered in the name        of Maybank Securities Pte. Ltd., 7,978,700 shares are registered in the name of CGS International Securities        Singapore Pte Ltd, 25,000,000 shares are registered in the name of DBS Nominees (Private) Limited, 15,000,000        shares are registered in the name of United Overseas Bank Nominees (Private) Limited and 39,282,500 shares        are registered in his own name. (2) The percentage of shareholding immediately before and after the transaction is calculated based on the       Company's number of issued ordinary shares (excluding treasury shares) of 840,778,624 shares as at 17       November 2026.

title: Oh Kuang Eng buys S$123K of Mi Material Holding Limited shares
body: Oh Kuang Eng bought 100,000 shares of Mi Material Holding Limited in a market transaction at S$1.2308 per share, for a total of S$123,076. The direct interest moved from 8,350,000 to 8,450,000 shares and the deemed interest from 361,990,500 to 362,250,500 shares. Total interest rises from 370,340,500 shares (74.80%) to 370,700,500 shares (74.89%).
deemed_interest_text: Mr. Oh Kuang Eng ("Mr. Oh") holds approximately 45.4% direct interest in the issued and paid up share capital of Mi Technovation Berhad ("MiTB"). MiTB holds 360,500,000 ordinary shares in the issued share capital of the Company. In addition, Ms. Yong Shiao Voon ("Ms. Yong"), an associate of Mr. Oh, holds 1,750,500 ordinary shares in the issued share capital of the Company. Accordingly, for the purpose of the Securities and Futures Act 2001 and the Securities and Futures (Disclosure of Interests) Regulation 2012, Mr. Oh has a deemed interest in the 362,250,500 ordinary shares held by MiTB and Ms. Yong.
remarks_text: The percentage of shareholdings set out above immediately before and after the transaction are calculated based on the issued share capital of the Company of 495,000,000 ordinary shares as at 16 November 2026.

title: BlackRock, Inc becomes substantial shareholder of Venture Corp Ltd with 5.10% stake
body: BlackRock, Inc reported a change in deemed interest in Venture Corp Ltd. The filing attributes the change to an increase in shares held as collateral. The transaction involved 1,305,315 shares. No shares are held directly. Total interest rises from 13,343,668 shares (4.65%) to 14,648,983 shares (5.10%). With this, the holder becomes a substantial shareholder of Venture Corp Ltd.

title: Dr Ng Chin Siau's stake in Q & M Dental Group (Singapore) Ltd falls to 54.85% from 55.80% after corporate action
body: Dr Ng Chin Siau's stake in Q & M Dental Group (Singapore) Ltd moved from 55.80% to 54.85% following a corporate action by the company. The filing attributes the change to the issue and allotment of new shares to Keera Capital pursuant to completion of the Thailand Acquisition. The transaction involved 16,375,714 shares. The number of shares held is unchanged at 528,797,889.
deemed_interest_text: By virtue of Section 4 of the Securities and Futures Act 2001 of Singapore, Dr Ng Chin Siau is deemed to be interested in the 528,647,789 ordinary shares held by QMH. Dr Ng Chin Siau is deemed to have an interest in his spouse's, Foo Siew Jiuan, 121,200 ordinary shares.
remarks_text: The change in interest arises from the issue and allotment of 16,375,714 new shares in Q & M to Keera Capital Ltd pursuant to the completion of the Thailand Acquisition, as announced by Q & M on 13 November 2026. The percentage shareholding before the change in interest is calculated based on Q & M's issued share capital of 947,620,661 ordinary shares (excluding treasury shares), as announced in Q & M‘s Share Buy-back Announcement dated 21 October 2026. The percentage shareholding after the change in interest is calculated based on Q & M's enlarged issued share capital of 963,996,375 ordinary shares (excluding treasury shares).
change_reason: the issue and allotment of new shares to Keera Capital pursuant to completion of the Thailand Acquisition

body: Pandanus Associates Inc's deemed interest in Centurion Accommodation REIT fell after a party linked to the holder sold 4,166,300 units in a market transaction at S$1.0508 per unit, for a total of S$4,377,765. FIL Holdings (Luxembourg) S.a r.l. is a wholly-owned subsidiary of FIL Limited. FIL Asia Holdings Pte Limited is a wholly-owned subsidiary of FIL Financial Services Holdings 2 Limited. FIL Financial Services Holdings 2 Limited is deemed interested in the direct and/or deemed interests of its direct and indirect subsidiaries.
